tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and terminal background (TUI slot `background`). Also the label colour on a filled accent or error button.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: dialogs, menus, the folded rail card, the connect card (TUI `backgroundPanel`).

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Active tab, toast, switch track, suggestion list, input ground in the composer (TUI `backgroundElement`; the TUI's cursor row).

tokens.name: menu
tokens.usage: A selected or cursor row on the web, one step past `inset`, so it never matches a pointer hover; also the terminal's selection and the TUI's menu ground (TUI `backgroundMenu`).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every hairline: pane dividers, dialog, menu and field borders, unpicked chips (TUI `border`). Decorative separation only: 1.5:1 dark, 1.4:1 light, so it never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: line-active
tokens.usage: A focused field's border, the active pane frame and a floating action's edge (TUI `borderActive`). 3:1 or better on paper in both themes (3.8 dark, 3.4 light).

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: The quietest rule, between dense rows (TUI `borderSubtle`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, surface, inset and menu (10.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: unpicked tabs, row subtitles, hint bars, the dialog close glyph. AA on all four grounds in both themes, and always a step stronger than `subtle` (the web raises it when needed).

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Quietest readable text: project heads, placeholders, ages, key legends. Derived at runtime from TUI `diffLineNumber`, raised until it holds 4.5:1 on all four grounds; `muted` is kept a step stronger. These are the claude theme's results.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Terracotta, the one accent (TUI `primary`): selection, focus, the wordmark brackets, running and unseen status, the filled action, links. AA as text on paper in both themes (5.6 dark, 4.7 light); `paper` on an accent fill is AA too.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: A quiet accent wash: picked chips, a row in move mode or mid-drag, a focused note. Source: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent)`.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Pointer hover and a menu's highlight: a neutral ink wash, never the accent. Source: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 7%, transparent)`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 1px solid, 1px offset. Follows the accent unless the user picks another slot in Settings (`focusAccent`).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Softened terracotta: the terminal's cyan, TUI markdown code and operators (TUI `secondary`).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and the terminal's blue (TUI `info`). AA on paper and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Checks passing, a finished step, the terminal's green. AA on paper and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: A wait you can clear: needs input, rate limited. Amber, always paired with a glyph (`?`, `◷`).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Broken until you act: error, dead engine, failed deletion; the danger button fill and a selected destructive menu item. A redder hue than `accent` in both themes (ΔE 20+), so a failed row never reads as a running one. Always paired with a glyph (`!`, `†`).

tokens.name: merged
tokens.usage: A merged PR, as GitHub draws it (TUI `syntaxType`).

tokens.name: diff-added
tokens.usage: Added-line text and the `+N` count. With the colourblind pref the TUI swaps in `diffAddedColorblind`.

tokens.name: diff-removed
tokens.usage: Removed-line text and the `-N` count.

tokens.name: diff-added-bg
tokens.usage: Behind an added line (TUI `diffAddedBg`).

tokens.name: diff-removed-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a removed line (TUI `diffRemovedBg`).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a dialog. The same in both themes; themes do not remap it.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "Rove Nerd Symbols", "IBM Plex Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The bracket wordmark only; brackets in `accent`.

styles.name: project-head
styles.usage: A rail project section's name, in `subtle`. Labels a group; the task rows under it read first.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Segmented tabs and the narrow bar's switch.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Chips, paths, branch names, keys, glyph columns, fields, placeholders.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The dialog close glyph and every field on a touch screen (16px keeps iOS from zooming).

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Wire usage footer into the status bar
styles.usage: A rail task row's title, the one thing in the list that reads first.

styles.name: dialog-title
styles.usage: A dialog's title at the title size: sentence case, ink, often quoting the user's own words. Never an uppercase kicker.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The worktree and its branch are removed. Tabs close.
styles.usage: Body copy, dialog text, menu items, settings descriptions.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: A section's small label above a list, in `muted`. At most one per region.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Hints under a field, toasts, buttons, small print.

fontSize.note: The only four sizes on the web. Utilities `text-meta`, `text-body`, `text-title`, `text-display`.

tokens.name: fs-meta
tokens.usage: Chips, hints, lists, buttons, mono structure.

tokens.name: fs-body
tokens.usage: Body, dialog copy, menu items; the page default.

tokens.name: fs-title
tokens.usage: Rail task titles and the wordmark.

tokens.name: fs-display
tokens.usage: The close glyph and touch-screen fields.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px step, used in halves and quarters. Rhythm in use: 2/3/4/6/8/10/12/14/18/20.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Knob inset in a switch; the focus-ring bleed a scroller pads.

tokens.name: space-0.75
tokens.usage: A list row's vertical padding; a tab's vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tab gap; menu padding; a stacked note's line gap.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Chip gap; label-over-field gap; a tab row's glyph indent; toast stack gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding and the gap between a row's glyph and title.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Field and chip horizontal padding; menu item padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a dialog's blocks.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Rail head padding; gap between trailing actions; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4.5
tokens.usage: Dialog vertical padding; gap above a second project section.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog horizontal padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: A small control inside a row or tab: fold toggles, project toggles, a tab's close box (`rounded-xs`). Menu items and suggestion rows use a concentric inner radius instead: `calc(var(--radius) - padding)`.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, rows, chips, fields, tabs, toasts (`rounded-sm`).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, the folded rail card (`rounded-md`).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The switch track and knob, scrollbar thumbs.

shadow.note: Only what floats casts a shadow: its own hairline border plus ONE soft shadow. Resting surfaces have none.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, row tips, floating actions.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the peeking rail.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The one line weight for every rule and outline; 0.5px on a 2x screen. Pair with a colour (`border-hairline border-line`).

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: The dialog scrim and dialog.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Right-click and dropdown menus.

tokens.name: z-row-tip
tokens.usage: A cut-off row title shown in full beside the row.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, bottom right.

tokens.name: container-reading
tokens.usage: A reading column (release notes, help).

tokens.name: container-cap
tokens.usage: A key-cap column in key guides.
